messages.subject: Re: Instalación de Wallace
messages.body_plain:
Hola Beli,

Lo que resulta es que hay un problema con el cran, comparto la respuesta que dá Daniel Lopez, quien le está haciendo el mantenimiento a Wallace:

Wallace was archived on CRAN today due to the archiving of a core dependency, leaflet.extras.

While we work on a permanent workaround to get the package back on CRAN, you can continue using the latest version of Wallace by installing it directly from GitHub.

To install Wallace, use the remotes package:

remotes::install_github("wallaceEcoMod/wallace")

If you find you are missing the dependency, you can install the specific version of leaflet.extras here:

remotes::install_github("trafficonese/leaflet...@v2.0.1")

We are actively investigating the best path forward to restore Wallace to CRAN. We will post an update to this board as soon as we have more news.

Thank you,

Daniel
The Wallace Team

Si continúan los problemas, me cuenta y tal vez podemos probar otro camino o charlar con Daniel sobre el problema específico.
Si el problema persiste, por fa compártame un pantallazo.

Saludos

messages.subject: Wallace v2 tutorial: Maxent via maxnet crashes after ENMevaluate ([is.lonlat] unknown crs)
messages.subject_clean: Wallace v2 tutorial: Maxent via maxnet crashes after ENMevaluate ([is.lonlat] unknown crs)
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
I’m new to SDM and I’ve been trying to work through the Wallace v2 tutorial step by step to learn the workflow properly.

My setup is: Windows 10, R 4.3.3, RStudio, Wallace 2.2.0, ENMeval 2.0.5.2, terra 1.8, raster 3.6-32

So far, most of the workflow has been working fine. I can:

download occurrence data from GBIF,
clean the occurrence records,
load WorldClim environmental data,
run BIOCLIM successfully,
and ENMevaluate also completes successfully in the Model step.

The problem only comes up when I try to run Maxent via maxnet in Wallace.

After ENMevaluate finishes, Wallace crashes with grey screen:

[is.lonlat] unknown crs
Error in if: missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
raster::extract

So as far as I can tell, the issue is not with the occurrence download or the environmental data in general, because the earlier steps work and BIOCLIM works too. The crash seems to happen specifically in the Maxent/maxnet part of the pipeline.

Since I’m still learning, I’m not sure whether I’m missing something obvious, or whether this could be a compatibility issue between the current versions of Wallace, ENMeval, terra, and raster.

Has anyone run into this before, or have any suggestions on what I should check next?

I’d really appreciate any help.

Thank you,
Yurii
